hooks.name: Keep simulation assumptions in sync
hooks.description: If the storm, fare, emission or buffer constants change, the steering file judges read must change too.

action.prompt: You just edited simulation parameters or logic. Check that config/params.py and the 'Model rules' in .kiro/steering/simulation-assumptions.md still describe the same model. If they differ, update the steering file to match the code. If the change could break a listed guarantee (more snow never makes anything faster, higher parking compliance never makes things worse), stop and say so instead.
